dogecoin.text: @elonmusk Hey Elon! We’ll cover your return ticket from space with Dogecoin—just drop a tweet to help us out a bit! You know, Dogecoin is the people’s currency, and you’re one of its biggest supporters! 😄 Maybe a few more ‘to the moon’ words would boost our motivation—what do you say?
